content.short: KuCoin is a centralized crypto exchange for spot trading, futures, margin, bots, and broader market access.
content.description: KuCoin is a global cryptocurrency exchange that combines spot markets, margin trading, futures, trading bots, funding accounts, and developer APIs in one platform. Its official product and help pages focus on giving users several ways to trade, transfer, and manage assets while keeping advanced tools available for more active strategies. In the TON context, KuCoin is relevant as an exchange where users can access Toncoin and move funds between trading and wallet flows, not as a TON native protocol built on chain.
content.meta: KuCoin offers spot, margin, futures, trading bots, funding tools, and exchange APIs for users who want broad crypto market access.
